structural_confirmation_note: Unlike ablation 1/2, this ablation does not bypass a call site (readLocalSlot is still invoked from the same call sites, with the same fully-qualified frame name); java.util.LinkedHashMap.containsKey/get are simple enough to be inlined by the JIT and are not a reliable JFR-sampled-frame signal. Structural confirmation instead reads the exact patched (or, for baseline, unmodified) source tree the image was built from (/opt/protos-source) and inspects ProtosObjectValue.readLocalSlot's method body directly, scoped to that single method so other legitimate containsKey usages elsewhere in the file do not produce false positives.
